text: Ember Park and Saltcombe Rovers had a thrilling match, filled with exciting chances and clutch moments. The better of the two, in terms of quality of opportunities, was Ember Park, who had xG of 2.14 to Saltcombe Rovers' 0.57 [F6, F30]. Despite this, Saltcombe took the lead early through Callum Okafor, increasing their chances of winning [F53]. Ember Park didn't give up, with Bram Ueda scoring to tie it up [F59]. However, it was Saltcombe Rovers who pulled through in the end. Tariq Orrin’s late goal at the 87th minute, with an xG of 0.22 [F88], dramatically swung the win probability by a massive 78 points [F87], securing the victory for Saltcombe Rovers.
